stated_limitation: The NWB file labels kinematics as meters/m/s, but values are on a millimeter scale; we report mm and mm/s.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000128 MC_Maze macaque M1/PMd delayed center-out reaching is the canonical dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct move-onset alignment and reach-direction computation, but all 182 units are used with no spike-quality inclusion criteria beyond a rate threshold in the GLM.
justification.analysis: Cosine tuning with an ANOVA plus rate-weighted-resultant shuffle null, circular statistics for preferred directions, and held-out Poisson GLMs constitute the standard, correct method set with the required null distributions.
justification.correctness: Reported values (71% tuned, circular corr 0.33, +30 ms lag, GLM pseudo-R2 0.0105 vs 0.0043) reproduce from the committed code, are internally consistent with the figures, and rest on sound held-out and shuffle statistics.
justification.figures: The population figures show the effect clearly with sample sizes, but the fig1 hand-speed panel is a broken plot and the fig3 example units are chosen by modulation depth, yielding low-rate units with poor cosine fits.
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and every headline number matches the figures, but the weak cross-epoch PD stability (corr 0.11) and the tiny GLM effect sizes go without explicit caveat and there is no limitations section.
justification.verdict: The core result is sound and well-supported; I would accept it after asking for the fig1 speed-panel fix and more representative example units.
